answer: Entry requires burning one earned credit that cannot be bought or transferred: it is issued only after an identity completes three verified tasks last epoch, and expires after one epoch, so credits cannot be stockpiled. A beacon publishes the verified-task list, and a cedar registry records which credit funded which identity. An operator wanting 100 fakes must complete 300 verified tasks, one credit per fake, and duplicated work is rejected before issuance. The signal exposing a farm is a burst of identical submissions from one operator: reviewers freeze that batch and burn its credits.
